On a fine March day Belgrave turned out in force to win and give a clean sweep of all the London "Opens". Paul Blagg won comfortably with Carl Lawton 3rd.

Paul Blagg proudly wore the colours for 3rd place behind winner Steve Barry and was backed up by Dorman, Lawton and Newnham. We had gone with a chance of medals but to win was something extra - 8 years since the last National 10 Victory but team work paid off.
And to ice the cake Ernie Obeng and Paul Blagg competed at Brisbane in the Commonwealth Games. Our walkers as usual performed at the highest levels.

Congratulations must go to Paul Blagg for his selection for the Commonwealth Games. By the time of reading this it will all be over and whether he succeeded or failed at least he got there which for many of us is a "pipe dream".

Four days later Wells reversed the result beating Ernie into second place. Our other representative in Brisbane Paul Blagg finished 13th in the 30 kilometres road walk in an excellent time of 2 30.42.
